title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
signature: def attention(q, k, v, mask=None) -> tuple
hints: Scores are q @ k^T over the last two axes. Use np.swapaxes(k, -1, -2) so leading batch axes are untouched.
Scale by 1 / sqrt(d_k), where d_k is the last dimension of q and k, not of v.
Apply the mask before the softmax by setting dropped scores to -inf. Then subtract the row max before exponentiating.
